name: Harbor
tagline: A canvas-drawn night harbour whose quay lamps shimmer on the water behind the headline, with a real booking form, for a small inn or sailing charter.
sections: Nav with brand, four links and a ghost booking action
Hero over a canvas harbour with moving lamp reflections, italic kicker, one booking form as the primary action
Harbour notices band styled as a tide table
Rooms as a ruled three-column list with prices
The morning sail as a timed log with a what-to-bring aside
Winter rate table beside the owners' story
Final call to action with a warm radial glow
